description:
## Yandex countdown

- The animated ring now follows the actual circular Yandex player button.
- Ring thickness, timer placement, orientation changes, and additional player
  buttons no longer shift the countdown.
- The timer can be displayed inside the button or over the lower edge of the
  ring.
- The Yandex button remains active while translated playback is paused.

Based on stable Morphe Patches 1.37.0. Enable pre-release patches for this
source in Morphe Manager.
